caption: The drawing features a garment that appears to be a shawl or capelet draped over a full, ankle-length skirt. The shawl is illustrated in a light, off-white or beige color, with detailed shading indicating folds and texture. It has a border decorated with a double row of trim; the outer edge is adorned with long, light-colored fringe that hangs down from the border. The trim appears textured or patterned, possibly suggesting embroidery or a woven detail. The skirt beneath the shawl is simply outlined in fine, faint lines, suggesting a large, dome-shaped volume with no additional detail or ornament. In the upper right area of the image, there is a smaller, secondary sketch of the same shawl seen from the back, showing the same trim and fringe placement, also rendered primarily in outlines and faint shading. The background of the drawing is a plain, neutral beige, and the entire composition is rendered in pencil with light washes for shading and color.
title: Shaker Shawl
